purpose: Current structural and parameter benchmarks for the adult mouse spinal interneuron feasibility prototype

resources.name: BrainGlobe allen_cord_20um
resources.reused: Segment extent, anatomy-layer contract, future atlas import target
resources.notReused: The feasibility renderer does not ship the atlas volume or claim atlas registration

resources.name: SpinalJ / SpineRacks
resources.reused: Whole-cord segmentation model and future transform/QC workflow
resources.notReused: 25 um sections are not presented as the BrainGlobe resampled resolution

resources.name: Neuroglancer
resources.reused: Layered view model, shareable state, 3D plus slice interaction pattern
resources.notReused: The first feasibility slice uses a smaller native Three.js renderer without external volumes

resources.name: NeuroMorpho.Org
resources.reused: Future SWC asset schema and completeness flags
resources.notReused: No morphology is positioned in atlas space without a validated transform

resources.name: Allen Mouse Spinal Cord Atlas
resources.reused: Marker evidence links and future section anchors
resources.notReused: Sparse 2D ISH is not represented as continuous single-cell 3D expression

resources.name: SPARC organ scaffolds
resources.notReused: No generic SPARC mouse spinal-cord scaffold is treated as source anatomy

resources.name: Fish1
resources.reused: Stable biological IDs, mutable segmentation IDs and versioned query concepts
resources.notReused: No zebrafish anatomy, taxonomy, counts or connectivity is transferred to adult mouse
